unit.explanation: Each evaluated case pairs one donor patient with the corresponding PDO.

platform.explanation: Assays were performed in patient-derived organoids (PDOs).

readout.explanation: Most PDO responses were categorized from normalized AUC; two CCA cases used published IC50 thresholds.

direction.explanation: Lower AUC or IC50 indicates greater drug sensitivity.

threshold_rule.explanation: PDO responses were grouped into sensitive/intermediate/resistant by Jenks Natural Breaks, except two IC50-based cases.

threshold_timing.explanation: Jenks categories were derived from the compared PDO AUC values rather than an independent prespecified cutoff.

patient_mapping.explanation: Patient IDs and aggregate agreement are reported, but machine-readable row-level assay and outcome pairs are not available in the parsed text.

regimen_match.explanation: PDOs generally received the patient therapy, with exceptions for unavailable drugs and the HO20 treatment sequence.

n_units.explanation: The clinical-correlation denominator was 11 patient/PDO cases.

split.explanation: This was a retrospective paired agreement analysis, not a held-out predictive-model validation.
